# Luxury Crystal Stamper and Scraper Set: Brilliant Nail Art, Made Simple

## Create Salon-Style Designs at Home

Turn your nails into a canvas with the PUEEN Crystal Stamper and Scraper Set. Each set includes two soft silicone stamper heads in pink and off-white, two scraper cards, and a silver stainless steel crystal handle. Press the stamper onto your image plate, roll it across your nail, and transfer detailed designs in one smooth motion.

## Designed for Easy Stamping

The soft, squishy silicone head picks up designs cleanly and conforms to the nail surface, so you don't need to press hard or roll it on your finger. Because the heads need no priming, you can start stamping right away. The 28mm head size suits most nail shapes, and the included replacement insert makes swapping styles quick.

## Mess-Free Results

The scraper removes excess polish from the image plate, leaving just the right amount for a crisp transfer. The sturdy, credit-card-style scrapers feel durable and make it easy to control the polish with every stroke.

## Start Your Home Nail Routine

Ideal for beginners and experienced DIY stylists alike, this set gives you everything you need to begin. Practice a few times to get comfortable with pressure and polish thickness, then experiment with new looks every week. Add the PUEEN Crystal Stamper and Scraper Set to your beauty kit and start creating your next manicure today.
